title: 第3章 未婚妻大乾第一女杀神第4章 你觉得本世子是讲规矩的人么
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
唰！
楚风见状，脸色骤变。
眼前这老者，正是他前身的爷爷，威震大乾的镇北王，楚天渊。
那根狰狞的狼牙棒携着恶风，直冲他的天灵盖而来，刮得他脸颊都有些生疼。
老头子这是真想一棒子结果了他这个龟孙子啊！
然而，就在那布满铁刺的棒头即将触及头皮的瞬间——
“噗通！”
一声闷响。
楚风双膝重重砸在冰凉的青石板上，跪得那叫一个结结实实。
“爷爷，孙儿错了！”
整个院子，刹那间死一般的寂静。
楚天渊高举的狼牙棒硬生生停在半空，手臂上的青筋还在微微颤动，他瞪大了眼睛，死死盯着跪在地上的孙子，那张老脸上写满了错愕。
这龟孙子……会下跪认错？
周围的下人们更是个个如同见了鬼，有人下意识地揉了揉眼睛，有人手里的扫帚“啪嗒”
一声掉在地上都毫无察觉。
世子爷竟然主动下跪了？
今天这太阳是打西边出来，还是说王府的顶要塌了？
“说！
你这龟孙子今天这么老实，是不是又在外面闯了什么塌天大祸？”
楚天渊回过神来，怒目圆瞪，但那根狼牙棒终究是没再落下去，只是语气里透着一股深深的疲惫和无奈。

“老爷子眼神够毒的啊？这都能看出来？”
楚风心里嘀咕一句，脸上却不敢有丝毫表露。
把太子妃给睡了这事，打死也不能说，他真怕老爷子一口气上不来，直接当场嗝屁。
他连忙从地上爬起来，小跑着到楚天渊身边，一把搀住老爷子的胳膊，满脸真诚，言辞恳切：“爷爷，您想到哪去了？孙儿是真心悔过！”
“父亲和两位叔叔刚刚为国捐躯，咱们镇北王府如今风雨飘摇，孙儿要是再跟以前一样混账，那还是人吗？”
“你小子……”
楚天渊浑浊的眼睛上下打量着他，狐疑道：“是脑袋被门夹了，还是被人夺舍了？怎么突然跟换了个人似的？”
楚风嘴角抽了抽。
看来自己这前身的混账形象，还真是深入人心，根深蒂固。
他只能一脸严肃，就差指天发誓了：“爷爷，我是真的想通了！
您放心，从今往后，我一定洗心革面，重振镇北王府的威名！”
“唉……”
楚天渊长长地叹了口气，摆了摆手，“算了，只要你小子别再给老头子我惹事就行。
等七日之后，你和霓凰成了婚，老头子我也就能彻底安心了！”
“霓凰？成婚？”
楚风神色一滞，一个名字瞬间从记忆深处浮现。
萧霓凰！
大乾四公之首，萧国公的孙女，容貌倾国倾城，位列大乾美人榜前三。
content_en:
Uh-huh!
When Chu Feng saw this, his expression suddenly changed.
The old man in front of him was none other than his predecessor's grandfather, the powerful King of Zhenbei, Chu Tianyuan.
The ferocious mace carried the evil wind and came straight towards his Tianling Cap, causing his cheeks to hurt a little.
The old man really wants to kill his little grandson with a stick!
However, at that moment when the head of the club covered with iron thorns was about to touch the scalp——
"Plop!"
There was a muffled sound.
Chu Feng's knees hit the cold bluestone floor hard, and he knelt so tightly that he was so firm.
"Grandpa, my grandson is wrong!"
The whole courtyard fell into deathly silence for an instant.
The mace held high by Chu Tianyuan stopped in mid-air, and the veins on his arms were still trembling slightly. He stared at his grandson kneeling on the ground with his eyes wide open, his old face full of astonishment.
This grandson...will he kneel down and admit his mistake?
The surrounding servants all seemed to have seen a ghost. Some people rubbed their eyes subconsciously, and the broom in someone's hand clicked.
It fell to the ground without even noticing.
The prince actually took the initiative to kneel down?
Is the sun rising in the west today, or is the roof of the palace about to collapse?
"Say!
You little grandson is so honest today. Did you cause another big disaster outside? "
Chu Tianyuan came back to his senses and glared angrily, but the mace did not fall again after all, but there was a deep exhaustion and helplessness in his tone.
"The old man's eyes are so vicious, aren't you? You can see this?"
Chu Feng muttered something in his heart, but did not dare to show it at all on his face.
He couldn't talk about sleeping with the Crown Princess even to death. He was really afraid that the old man wouldn't be able to breathe and would just belch on the spot.
He quickly got up from the ground, trotted to Chu Tianyuan, took the old man's arm, with a sincere face and sincere words: "Grandpa, where did you think you were? My grandson is truly sorry!"
"My father and two uncles have just sacrificed their lives for the country. Our Zhenbei Palace is now in dire straits. If our grandson continues to be a bastard like before, will he still be a human being?"
"You kid..."
Chu Tianyuan looked him up and down with his turbid eyes, and asked suspiciously: "Did his head get caught in the door, or was his body snatched away? Why does he suddenly look like a different person?"
The corners of Chu Feng's mouth twitched.
It seems that the bastard image of his predecessor is really deeply rooted in people's hearts.
He could only look serious, almost swearing to the sky: "Grandpa, I really figured it out!
Don't worry, from now on, I will definitely change my mind and revive the reputation of Zhenbei Palace! "
"Alas..."
Chu Tianyuan let out a long sigh and waved his hand, "Forget it, as long as you don't cause any more trouble for me, the old man.
When you and Nihuang get married in seven days, old man, I will be able to feel completely at ease! "
"Nihuang? Married?"
Chu Feng's expression froze, and a name instantly emerged from the depths of his memory.
Xiao Nihuang!
The granddaughter of Xiao Guogong, the first of the Four Dukes of Daqian, has an alluring appearance and ranks among the top three beauties of Daqian.
